description:
Updates a post or page as the connected user — only the fields you pass change; everything else behaves as a normal editor save. Moving something TO publish needs the site’s “Publish without your review” extra; editing an already-published post follows the user’s normal edit permission. publish_at schedules a draft or pending post, or moves a schedule; it is refused on a live post. status=draft cancels a schedule, and status=publish on a scheduled post publishes it now. Can set the AI description / Topics for AI, categories, tags and the featured image alongside the content, or on their own. CAUTION: fields REPLACE — passing content replaces the current body (posts and pages keep a revision of the old one, but a content type without revision support does not), and a categories/tags list replaces the current list ([] clears it). The response includes the post’s AI-readability grade after the save. A page a page builder owns (Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder and similar) refuses a body replacement — its real content lives in the builder, and the tool says so instead of silently changing nothing; every other field still works there. HOW TO WRITE EACH TYPE — keep the shape the target already has: a page ("page", or any hierarchical type) stays a short standing page (no article opening, no invented sections, no categories or tags), and a post stays an article. Do not rewrite a page into an article because it reads thin — a Terms page is not improved by an introduction. On any page that states terms or promises, never introduce a fact the page did not already carry: an invented detail there is a commitment the owner never made.

Write to pass the site's AI-readability checks: keep every paragraph under about 120 words — never longer than 150 — so an engine can lift a clean, self-contained passage; prefer short sentences and plain words over long, clause-heavy ones; ground claims in concrete specifics — figures, names, versions — that the brief or well-established knowledge provides, never invented ones; and where a claim leans on official documentation or a well-known source, link it inline with <a> — only addresses you are certain exist, never a guessed URL, and only a few: the article must stay prose, not a link list.

MARKUP: scripts, event handlers, javascript: links, iframes, style elements, SVG and attributes this site does not allow in post content are refused, even under an administrator’s login, and nothing is written. Markup the owner already stored on the page stays, and is yours to keep or move, not to change or copy. Embed a video or post by its URL in an embed block. Write a literal “<” as <.

categories.description: Categories, by name — REPLACES the post’s current categories ([] clears them). Existing names are matched; a new name is created only when the connected user may manage categories (same rule as wp-admin).

content.description: New body, as HTML. Replaces the current body — a revision keeps the old one only on content types that support revisions (posts and pages do). Refused on a page a page builder owns.

description.description: The page’s AI description — one plain sentence (≤300 chars). Pass an empty string to clear it (the excerpt then takes over).

featured_image.description: The featured image: an existing attachment ID (e.g. "123"), or an http(s) image URL to import into the media library (needs the user’s upload permission; the site’s file-type and size rules apply). Empty string removes the featured image.

featured_image_alt.description: Alt text for an imported featured image.

focus.description: The search this page should answer — what every worklist row measures it against. Comma-separate several; the first is the one it is judged on. Empty string clears the choice. ⚠️ Changing it marks the page’s stored verdict out of date until the sweep reads it again.

publish_at.description: Schedule it to go live at this exact time, with its UTC offset: 2026-11-05T09:00:00+06:00. At least a minute ahead. Needs the site’s Write level and “Publish without your review” extra, plus the user’s publish permission. The answer’s `scheduledFor` gives the time in the site’s own timezone. ⚠️ WordPress publishes through WP-Cron, which needs site traffic or a real cron job; list-content shows `missedSchedule` when a time passed and nothing happened.

seo_title.description: The title a search result shows, instead of the post title. Empty string clears it. ⛔ On a site where an SEO plugin owns titles the WHOLE call is refused rather than storing a value nothing serves — omit this field there; every other one still works.

status.description: draft (default), pending, or publish. publish needs the site’s “Publish without your review” extra plus the user’s publish permission.

tags.description: Tags, by name — REPLACES the post’s current tags ([] clears them). Existing names are matched; a new name is created only when the connected user may manage tags (same rule as wp-admin).

topics.description: Manual Topics for AI — short, specific keywords (deduped, trimmed and capped by the site’s topic settings).

topics_derive.description: Whether this page should ALSO derive topics from its tags & categories.

name: agentimus-update-content

featuredImage.description: { id, url } of the featured image, or null when none is set.

focus.description: The search this page is measured against — the author’s own choice, empty when none is set and the reported search stands in.

scheduledFor.description: When it goes live, in the site’s own timezone with its offset. Empty unless status is future.

seoTitle.description: The title search results show for this page. Empty when none is set, and ALWAYS empty when an SEO plugin owns titles on this site — in which case this field is not the one that decides them.

title: Update a post or page
